topics.title: Casio Guitar Frustration
topics.summary: Howard Stern and his co-hosts attempt to play a Casio guitar, leading to confusion about its functionality and repeated attempts with little success. Fred eventually figures out how it works while others express frustration over the instrument's limited capabilities.

topics.title: Radio Hosts Discuss Sex Surveys & Elvis Impersonators
topics.summary: Several radio shows discuss explicit sex surveys conducted by DJs Mark Stevens and Jim Pruitt in Houston, alongside discussions of their own sexual lives. Other segments feature an Elvis impersonator named Todd Elvis performing at '50s car shows while detailing bizarre topics discussed on WFBQ FM in Indianapolis and WAP FM in Jacksonville, including conversations about male genitalia.

topics.title: Howard Stern Anniversary Show - Focus 21 Promotion
topics.summary: During a Howard Stern anniversary show segment, guests Todd Elvis and Robin discuss personal anecdotes alongside promoting the Focus 21 hairspray brand through demonstrations at beauty salons like ‘The Ultimate Cut.’ The conversation shifts to recalling Greg’s past experiences and mentioning sales figures for the product across New York and New Jersey.”} ظهرت خلال حلقة الذكرى السابعة لـ هورد ستيرن، مناقشات بين تود إيلفيس وروبين حول القصص الشخصية بالإضافة إلى الترويج لمستحضرات التجميل من العلامة التجارية فوس 21. تم عرض المنتج في صالونات الحلاقة مثل

topics.title: Radio Sales & Disappearance
topics.summary: Alan B. Combs and Joe E. Reynolds discuss a radio station’s collapse due to inflated ratings manipulated by salespeople, reminiscing about Greg Light who frequently dined with Howard while discussing personality changes and soliciting letters from female listeners.

topics.title: Answering Machine Disputes
topics.summary: Jackie Marley repeatedly expresses frustration with Greg and Gary’s slow answering machine, demanding they change it to a shorter message. He argues about call volume, perceived lack of responsiveness, and the impracticality of leaving long messages on hold while emphasizing his own importance and continued behavior.

topics.title: NBC Reunion - Personal Changes and Revelations
topics.summary: During the broadcast, Robin and Howard discuss their former colleague Greg’s significant changes since leaving NBC, including altered appearance, erratic behavior like playing Russian roulette, legal issues involving Leona Helmsley, and revelations about Hemingway's family history. The conversation also includes discussions of personal vanity and a focus on newsworthy events such as the attempted juror interference trial and Gregory Hemingway’s claim to be a transvestite.
